The subsequent test uses `xhr :delete` for the real path, but the automatic-group guard test uses the wrong verb and depends on group id 1 being a seeded automatic group, so it bypasses the actual DELETE route and would not catch routing/verb regressions. This is a concrete, substantive test-quality concern about newly added code, not a shipped-code defect.
